prompt: Camera movement: aerial drone tracking shot from a top-down perspective, looking straight down at the subject. The camera is positioned directly overhead, following the subject from above as they move through the scene. The camera matches the subject's speed and direction, keeping them centered in frame throughout. The movement is smooth and weightless, like a drone locked onto the subject from a bird's eye view. The surrounding environment is revealed naturally as the subject moves through it.

Camera movement: Single continuous shot. Gentle slow zoom-in on the subject at a perfectly constant speed from the first frame to the last. The camera is locked on a tripod, fixed in one position throughout. Only the lens zooms, magnifying the image evenly with consistent perspective. The speed is identical at every moment, steady, smooth, uniform from start to finish. Like a timelapse camera with a motorized zoom set to one constant rate.

Camera movement: Single continuous shot. Gentle slow zoom-out from the subject at a perfectly constant speed from the first frame to the last. The camera stays in one fixed position the entire time, it is the lens that widens, the camera itself stays completely still. The framing gets progressively wider, revealing more of the scene evenly from the center outward toward all edges. The speed is identical at every moment, steady, smooth, uniform. Like a motorized lens zoom set to one constant rate.

Camera movement: smooth forward journey through the environment, the camera floats forward through the environment at a constant speed, always advancing, adapting its path to navigate the space organically. It flows around obstacles, through openings, along curves, always moving forward but finding its way through the scene naturally. Like a drone gliding through the space. The movement is smooth, weightless, and continuous from the first frame to the last. Perspective and depth increase naturally as the camera advances deeper into the scene.

Camera movement: parallax move, the camera moves physically sideways through space at a constant speed, smooth, lateral, straight. Foreground elements slide across the frame faster than the background, creating clear depth separation between layers. The movement emphasizes the distance between objects at different depths. Like a camera mounted on rails gliding sideways. One axis only: purely lateral, one speed, one direction.

Camera movement: vertical reveal, the camera glides straight upward at a perfectly constant speed, smooth, vertical, steady. The camera stays perfectly level throughout the ascent, always facing forward at the same angle. Like a drone rising straight up. The whole frame lifts evenly, gradually revealing more of the scene above. One axis only: purely vertical, one speed, one direction.
